integrity: Exact proofs are supplied; numerical tests are corroborative and not proofs; historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: One real signal dimension; normalized Gaussian STFT; circular annuli with fixed area only.
Asymptotic uniformity is for fixed annular area L; no claims for growing width.
An equivalent formula may be present in unlocated studies of uniform Poisson mixtures or radial Fock Toeplitz operators.
title: Exact Hermite-mode staircase and oscillatory norm correction for Gaussian annular localization
